connector.name: Payagent MCP
connector.registryDescription: Gives AI agents a wallet: pay x402 APIs (USD + EUR), check balances, self-onboard in one tool call.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package payagent-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the stevemilton account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: ARISPAY_API_KEY
env.description: ArisPay developer API key (ap_live_… / ap_test_…). Optional — the bootstrap_agent tool can self-provision one from just an email.
